description: Pre-generated tech stack profiles and capability-slot recommendations for /designer-dashboards:init. Mirrors templates/design-presets/catalog.json.

profiles.name: Next.js 16 Lean Default (Designer Dashboards)
profiles.summary: Lean server-first Next.js 16 + Tailwind v4 + ApexCharts + TanStack Table + React Hook Form + Zod + Zustand + Sonner + Lucide.
recommendedFor: Fastest time-to-first-dashboard with minimal config
Teams wanting zero-config @core/@layouts/@menu + ApexCharts presets

profiles.name: Next.js 16 + shadcn (Base UI) + TanStack + Clerk + Sentry
profiles.summary: Full-featured production SaaS stack: Next.js 16, Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui on Base UI, Recharts/Evil Charts, TanStack Form/Query/Table + Dice Table, Zustand, Nuqs, kbar, Clerk, Sentry, OxLint/Oxfmt, Husky, tweakcn.
recommendedFor: Production multi-tenant SaaS dashboards with managed auth (Clerk) and error tracking (Sentry)
Teams preferring Base UI + shadcn/ui + tweakcn theming, URL-synced table filters (nuqs), and Rust-speed linting (OxLint/Oxfmt)

profiles.name: React 19 + Vite 8 Client SPA
profiles.summary: Fast client-side SPA with React 19, Vite 8, React Router, TanStack Query, Zustand, ApexCharts, TanStack Table, React Hook Form + Zod, Sonner.
recommendedFor: Internal tools, admin consoles behind an existing REST/OpenAPI backend, or static/CDN hosting
Teams that do not need SSR or Next.js server components

profiles.name: Real-Time Ops, AI & Telemetry Console
profiles.summary: High-frequency monitoring & AI-ops stack: Next.js 16, Tailwind v4, ApexCharts (<LiveChart>), TanStack Query, Zustand, Nuqs, Sentry, OxLint/Oxfmt.
recommendedFor: AI ops, observability, crypto/trading, or logistics telemetry dashboards
Streaming SSE/WebSocket metrics with shareable URL filter state

profiles.name: Vue 3 + Vite + Pinia Dashboard
profiles.summary: Vue 3 Composition API + Vite + Pinia + Vue-i18n + ApexCharts + TanStack Vue Table + VeeValidate + Zod + Vue Sonner.
recommendedFor: Vue teams wanting full Designer Dashboards token, nav IR, and chart/table parity

profiles.name: Angular Zoneless + Signals Enterprise
profiles.summary: Modern zoneless Angular with Signals, Tailwind v4, ApexCharts, Angular Reactive Forms, and Lucide Angular.
recommendedFor: Enterprise Angular teams migrating from Fuse-style architectures

profiles.name: Mantine v8 Dashboard (CSS Modules, No Tailwind)
profiles.summary: Complete React dashboard suite using Mantine Core/Hooks/Notifications/Dates with CSS Modules + OpenDesign CSSVariablesResolver (no Tailwind).
recommendedFor: Security dashboards, developer tools, and SaaS consoles needing rich forms/dates/modals out of the box

profiles.name: HeroUI v3 (React Aria + Tailwind v4)
profiles.summary: Modern polished SaaS stack combining HeroUI v3, React Aria accessibility, and Tailwind v4 bridged to OpenDesign OKLCH tokens.
recommendedFor: Modern SaaS applications prioritizing polished out-of-the-box aesthetics and React Aria accessibility

profiles.name: Chakra UI v3 (Ark UI Foundation, No Tailwind)
profiles.summary: Composable design system with Chakra UI v3 semantic tokens, Ark UI state machines, and Emotion (no Tailwind).
recommendedFor: Teams building a customizable, internally consistent design system with composable primitives

profiles.name: Material UI v7 Enterprise (CSS Variables, No Tailwind)
profiles.summary: Enterprise React stack with Material UI v7 cssVariables theme, Emotion, and OpenDesign token bridge (no Tailwind).
recommendedFor: Large enterprise applications requiring mature Material UI patterns and strict theme contracts

profiles.name: Ant Design Admin (ConfigProvider, No Tailwind)
profiles.summary: Data-heavy admin console using Ant Design ConfigProvider cssVar + darkAlgorithm synced with OpenDesign tokens (no Tailwind).
recommendedFor: Data-intensive enterprise admin portals and back-office operations

profiles.name: PrimeReact Enterprise Widgets & Tables
profiles.summary: Enterprise widget & table suite with PrimeReactProvider, PrimeIcons, and OpenDesign CSS variable bridge (Tailwind optional).
recommendedFor: Data-intensive enterprise dashboards needing rich built-in tables and widgets

profiles.name: daisyUI v5 + Tailwind v4
profiles.summary: Rapid semantic-class UI with daisyUI v5 @plugin theme bridged to OpenDesign light/dark tokens.
recommendedFor: Rapidly prototyped, cleanly themed dashboards with concise Tailwind utility/component classes

profiles.name: Base UI Headless Primitives (No Tailwind)
profiles.summary: Unstyled, accessible @base-ui/react primitives styled directly with OpenDesign CSS variables and data-* state selectors.
recommendedFor: Custom design systems wanting full visual ownership on top of Base UI accessibility

profiles.name: coss ui (Base UI + Tailwind v4)
profiles.summary: Cal.com-inspired minimal SaaS product UI built on @base-ui/react, Tailwind v4, and class-variance-authority.
recommendedFor: Modern minimal SaaS product interfaces with crisp typography and Base UI primitives

profiles.name: React Bits (Animated UI, Shaders & Backgrounds)
profiles.summary: High-craft animated components, aurora/shader backgrounds, spotlight cards, and click sparks with reduced-motion guards.
recommendedFor: Distinctive animated web interfaces and interactive product showcases (check license for component redistribution)

profiles.name: Magic UI (Bento Grids & Animated Effects)
profiles.summary: Animated bento grids, border beams, number tickers, and gradient text effects built with Tailwind v4 and motion/react.
recommendedFor: Animated dashboards, bento KPI layouts, and polished visual highlights

profiles.name: Aceternity UI (3D Cards, Spotlights & Beams)
profiles.summary: Interactive 3D perspective cards, spotlights, moving borders, background beams, and floating docks wired to OpenDesign tokens.
recommendedFor: Creative interactive dashboards, hero sections, and marketing/product hybrids

profiles.name: 21st.dev AI Registry + Base UI
profiles.summary: AI coding-agent-ready component registry (components.json + @21st-dev) on Base UI + Tailwind v4 + OpenDesign tokens.
recommendedFor: AI-assisted UI prototyping with shadcn/Base UI-compatible community components

profiles.name: Motion Primitives (motion/react)
profiles.summary: Restrained, accessible animation primitives (TextEffect, AnimatedNumber, SlidingNumber, MorphingDialog, TransitionPanel) with MotionConfig reducedMotion='user'.
recommendedFor: Interfaces needing tactile micro-interactions and physics-driven transitions

profiles.name: Ark UI Headless State Machines (No Tailwind)
profiles.summary: Zag.js state-machine headless primitives (@ark-ui/react) styled via OpenDesign CSS variables (no Tailwind).
recommendedFor: Multi-brand or strict-a11y design systems built on deterministic state machines

profiles.name: UnoCSS (@unocss/preset-wind4)
profiles.summary: Instant on-demand atomic CSS engine with presetWind4, directives, variant groups, and OpenDesign theme bridge.
recommendedFor: Teams wanting utility-first CSS with full preset control and minimal CSS output

profiles.name: Panda CSS + Base UI (Zero-Runtime CSS-in-JS)
profiles.summary: Type-safe build-time CSS-in-JS (@pandacss/dev) with OpenDesign semanticTokens, cva recipes, and @base-ui/react primitives.
recommendedFor: TypeScript-first custom design systems wanting full ownership without Tailwind

profiles.name: vanilla-extract + Ark UI (Zero-Runtime TS CSS)
profiles.summary: Zero-runtime stylesheets in TypeScript (.css.ts + @vanilla-extract/recipes) paired with @ark-ui/react state-machine primitives.
recommendedFor: Type-safe React applications without Tailwind wanting static CSS extraction

profiles.name: StyleX (Compile-Time Atomic CSS)
profiles.summary: Meta's compile-time atomic CSS (@stylexjs/stylex + @stylexjs/unplugin) with defineVars bridged to OpenDesign tokens.
recommendedFor: Large-scale apps requiring deterministic, collision-free atomic CSS at compile time

profiles.name: Open Props (CSS Design Tokens + JIT)
profiles.summary: Lightweight CSS custom-property foundation combining Open Props (postcss-jit-props) with OpenDesign semantic color tokens.
recommendedFor: Minimalist CSS-first dashboards avoiding heavy styling frameworks
